heading: Lesson Fifteen: Adorning oneself with the prescribed morals for every Muslim

paragraphs.text: Among them are: truthfulness, honesty, chastity, bashfulness, bravery, generosity, loyalty, abstaining from all that Allah has forbidden, good neighborliness, assisting those in need according to one's ability, and other morals that the Qur’an or Sunnah has prescribed.

source.title: IMPORTANT LESSONS FOR THE GENERAL UMMAH
